summary.source_method: CTMC positive M-matrix; exact source 9-node q rates, OPR=3; CMB Planck R_ul and R_lu for each of 14 lines
assumptions: Homogeneous stationary gas, 15 source levels, 210 H2 source transitions, optically thin escape, CMB isotropic blackbody T=2.72548*(1+z) K
No actual cosmological thermal-history IVP, source high-J extrapolation J>8, no owner source switch, no molecular abundance
Radiation A frequencies are those in Neufeld2026 dataset, not CDMS2011 original owner accepted lines
